item.title: Actor Robert Duvall dies at 95, wife announces
item.description: He died "peacefully at home, surrounded by love and comfort."

item.title: New York Democrat pushes solar legislation while Republicans want more local control
item.description: New York State Senator Pete Harckham has introduced a suite of legislation to promote solar energy, including faster local permits, tax credits, and a mandate for state-owned properties to install solar panels.

item.title: New York state pension fund valued at $297b amid calls to divest from ICE-linked tech
item.description: New York's pension fund, worth $297.8 billion, earned a 2.44% return in Q3 and 12.50% in the first nine months of the fiscal year, with a portfolio consisting of 40% public equities, 13.8% private equity, 23.3% cash, bonds, and mortgages, 14% real estate, and 8.9% credit, absolute return strategies, and opportunistic alternatives.

item.title: Oscar-winning filmmaker Frederick Wiseman dies, leaving legacy of American institutions
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Frederick Wiseman, the celebrated director of “Titicut Follies” and dozens of other documentaries whose in-depth, unadorned movies comprised a unique and revelatory history of American institutions, died Monday at age 96. The death was announced in a joint statement from his family and from his production company, Zipporah Films. Additional details [...]
